data.name: Setting.billing.vat_rate.Help
data.value: Decimal rate: 0.19 for 19%. To be confirmed by the chartered accountant.

data.name: Setting.billing.daily_contribution_excl_vat.Help
data.value: Amount per day and per rented vehicle (2026 finance law), part of the VAT base.

data.name: Setting.billing.stamp_duty.Help
data.value: Amount added to each invoice. Value to be provided by the chartered accountant (0.000 meanwhile).

data.name: Setting.bookings.hold_duration.Label
data.value: Hold time of a web request

data.name: Setting.bookings.hold_duration.Help
data.value: How long a web request keeps a vehicle of its category before it expires if no agent validates it (24 h by default).

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_enabled.Help
data.value: Keep it off until the legal destruction procedure is validated (official report, law 2004-63).

data.name: Setting.customers.document_image_retention_days.Help
data.value: Days kept after the person's last closed rental, or after the upload (400 by default).

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_age.Help
data.value: Age on the pick-up date, in years (21 by default).

data.name: Setting.drivers.minimum_license_years.Help
data.value: Years since the licence was issued, on the pick-up date (2 by default).

data.name: Setting.fleet.preparation_buffer.Help
data.value: Time added after each return before the vehicle can leave again (2 h by default). Availability takes it into account at once.

data.name: Setting.outbox.processed_retention.Help
data.value: Processed background messages are deleted every night beyond this duration (30 days by default); failed messages are kept.

data.name: Setting.pricing.late_return_tolerance.Help
data.value: Delay allowed before one more rental day is counted (59 min by default).
